systems.system: Djibouti Digital Foundations Project connectivity for MDAs
systems.platform: purchased internet capacity; LANs for some institutions
systems.owner: Government of Djibouti with World Bank financing (P174461)
systems.tiers: pilot phase of 33 ministries, departments and agencies, 11 in Djibouti city and 22 in the regions, the first still being connected at February 2026; a generalisation phase of roughly 100 more

note: The report counts ministries, departments and agencies, in the capital and the regions, and names no regional council or commune among them; the connection is to central bodies and their regional offices, so no fact is taken. Excerpt only: the capture ends within section 6.1.
